short: Metal Organic Framework-Derived Metal Phosphates as Electrod
title: Metal Organic Framework-Derived Metal Phosphates as Electrode Materials for Supercapacitors

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Supercapacitor electrodes need high specific capacitance with rate capability; MOFs offer surface area but conduct and cycle poorly. Substituting the BTC ligands of a Ni-MOF with phosphate should give a metal phosphate that keeps the rod architecture and adds redox-active, better-conducting framework.
states.detail: Absorbed: e1 (HYP/need), e2 (HYP/hypothesis), e3 (DES/base_system), e4 (DES/route), e5 (DES/variable_sweep), e6 (PRC/synthesis)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Carboxylate coordination of BTC is replaced by P-O and O-P-O bonding in the derived solid. The derived solid is largely amorphous with a weak crystalline texture matched to a nickel phosphate card.
states.detail: Absorbed: e7 (STR/chemistry/bonding), e8 (STR/phase/identity), e9 (STR/microstructure/shape), e10 (STR/microstructure/porosity). Premises: Ni-BTC forms 1D zigzag chains of tetraaqua-nickel(II) units cross-linked by hydrogen bonding into a 3D network; Infrared bands at 1120-910 cm-1 are P-O stretching and at 600-530 cm-1 O-P-O bending; JCPDS card 04-010-2575 gives the reflections of Ni2(PO3)4

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Sheet resistance of the electrode film falls from 1049.42 to 714.13 ohm/sq after substitution. Charge storage is Faradaic, through a quasi-reversible Ni(II)/Ni(III) redox couple, not double-layer.
states.detail: Absorbed: e11 (PRP/value), e12 (PRP/behavior_class), e13 (PRP/value), e14 (MEC/pathway). Premises: A loosely bound porous electrode shortens the ion diffusion length, takes up more ions and accommodates volume change during redox; Phosphate groups stabilise the framework and help electron transfer during redox

states.title: Performance state
states.head: The electrode keeps about 54% of its capacitance after 10 000 cycles at 6 A/g at near-unity coulombic efficiency

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Ligand substitution turns a Ni-MOF into a porous metal phosphate that works as a high-capacitance supercapacitor electrode

nodes.title: SEM:SE, F4
nodes.head: Smooth faceted microrods become thicker rods whose surfaces are covered in granular particles and loose debris
nodes.solves: The derived solid inherits the microrod form of the MOF but the rods swell and their surfaces become loose and rough

nodes.title: ECHEM:EIS, F5
nodes.head: Four-point-probe sheet resistance of the electrode films: 1049.42 ohm/sq for the MOF and 714.13 ohm/sq for the derived phosphate. In the Nyquist panel the derived electrode's arc is the larger one and does not close within 14 ohm, while the MOF arc closes near 10 ohm; only the high-frequency intercept is lower for the derived, ~1.0 against ~1.4 ohm
nodes.solves: Sheet resistance of the electrode film falls from 1049.42 to 714.13 ohm/sq after substitution
nodes.note: stated in the text with no figure; the films are 8:1:1 active:carbon black:PVDF, so the measured resistance is that of the composite, not the phase audit node: the figure shows the discrepancy with the text, which reads this panel as a smaller semicircle and lower charge-transfer resistance for the derived electrode; the intercepts are read from the inset
nodes.detail: f7: Four-point-probe sheet resistance of the electrode films: 1049.42 ohm/sq for the MOF and 714.13 ohm/sq for the derived phosphate; f11: In the Nyquist panel the derived electrode's arc is the larger one and does not close within 14 ohm, while the MOF arc closes near 10 ohm; only the high-frequency intercept is lower for the derived, ~1.0 against ~1.4 ohm

nodes.title: ECHEM, ECHEM:galvanostatic, F5
nodes.head: At 1 A/g the derived electrode discharges for about 720 s against about 180 s for the MOF over the same 0-0.45 V window. Capacitance of the derived electrode falls from ~1630 F/g at 1 A/g to ~1045 F/g at 20 A/g, keeping 64%, against ~400 to ~85 F/g and 19% for the MOF
nodes.solves: Specific capacitance reaches ~1630 F/g at 1 A/g, four times the pristine MOF, and still ~1045 F/g at 20 A/g
nodes.note: read off the time axes of the two panels; both panels show the discharge branch only although the caption calls them charge-discharge curves, and the second panel carries one sample although its caption names both the 64% and 19% retentions are printed on the panel; the two end values are read against the 0-1600 F/g axis
nodes.detail: f9: At 1 A/g the derived electrode discharges for about 720 s against about 180 s for the MOF over the same 0-0.45 V window; f10: Capacitance of the derived electrode falls from ~1630 F/g at 1 A/g to ~1045 F/g at 20 A/g, keeping 64%, against ~400 to ~85 F/g and 19% for the MOF
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for e13 (f10).

nodes.title: ECHEM:galvanostatic, F5
nodes.head: At 6 A/g the capacitance holds ~1090 F/g for about 1800 cycles, steps down to ~830 F/g and then fades to ~580 F/g at 10 000 cycles while coulombic efficiency stays near 100%
nodes.solves: The electrode keeps about 54% of its capacitance after 10 000 cycles at 6 A/g at near-unity coulombic efficiency
nodes.note: 580 against 1090 F/g is the quoted 53.65% retention; the step near 1800-2000 cycles is a discontinuity the text does not mention
